findings.title: Client attribution resolves a client by claimed client_domain without binding the account (root cause: unverified client_domain signature)
Any contract's transfer() is reported as a token payment without contract or asset binding
Shared OkHttp client follows redirects and re-sends the custom auth header to the redirect target
SEP-24 deposit stores the caller-supplied asset issuer, not the configured issuer
Empty client_domain sends a null signing key into JWT verification, causing an unhandled error instead of a 403
SEP-24 deposit request metric is created but never incremented
SEP-31 PATCH always fails asset lookup because stored asset ID is passed to a code-only lookup
Fiat or mismatched asset code is cast to StellarAssetInfo, causing a 500 instead of a 400
SEP-24 deposit and withdraw skip sign and magnitude validation when no min/max is configured; invalid amounts reach the platform
Failed transactions are converted into completed payment operations
findings.evidence: ledger/LedgerClientHelper.java:359 `OperationResult opResult = operationResults == null ? null : operationResults[opIndex];`

findings.title: Firm quote and price fan-out have no per-caller limit, so any SEP-10 account can drive unbounded rate calls and stored quotes
SEP-45 validate issues a JWT for the account named in the args after checking only the server's signature and the simulation error flag
SEP-12 PUT writes to the business server before the SEP-31 customer-ID ownership claim
SEP-45 getChallenge signs for any home_domain; the allowlist applies only at validate
SEP-45 validate does not check the contract and function of submitted auth entries
SEP-10 validation never verifies the client_domain signature, so a whitelisted client_domain can be claimed without the wallet's key
SEP-12 DELETE skips memo check when the account is the token's muxed address
SEP-12 id-path GET/PUT never binds the request memo to the token memo
ApiKeyFilter lets every OPTIONS request bypass the API key check
Unverified client_domain sets the client name when client attribution is optional
Legacy ownership fallback lets muxed sub-accounts of a G-account read transactions stored under the plain G-account (SEP-24, same pattern in SEP-6)
Firm SEP-38 quotes are consumed by any authenticated caller who knows the quote ID; ownership is only checked on GET /quotes
ApiKeyFilter logs the full query string of every request, including any token passed in the URL
Unauthenticated SEP-10 challenge makes server fetch attacker-chosen client_domain; mainnet private-IP check is pre-fetch only and misses IPv6 ULA
SEP-24 deposit stores the caller-supplied asset issuer, not the configured issuer
Horizon getTransaction returns failed transactions as completed payment operations
ApiAuthHelper.forApiKey ignores its authorizationHeader argument
SEP-38 auth-enforced setting is declared but never read
getAccountRpc uses the first ledger entry without checking that its key matches the requested account
SEP-45 validate crashes with an unhandled exception on auth entries without contract args
SEP-45 getChallenge indexes simulation results without checking they exist
SEP-45 verifyServerSignature throws unchecked exception on malformed server signature map
Quote-less SEP-31 POST with a different destination asset stores no amount_out and an unpriced destination asset
Quote-less strict-send amount_out is not checked to be positive after subtracting the fee
POST with quote_id on an asset that does not support quotes fails with a server error
RPC helper throws unchecked NPE or IndexOutOfBounds on empty, "null" or empty-array JSON-RPC body
Weak-secret validator is never called in the submitted set and skips empty secrets
SEP-31 PATCH with no fields object throws NullPointerException instead of 400
formatAmount uses the JVM default locale, so SEP-31 amounts can be stored with a comma decimal separator
ReflectionUtil.getField swallows read failures into a default value and has no target type check
Malformed transfer() invocation args throw unchecked exceptions and abort parsing of the whole transaction
xdrMemoToString renders hash memos as base64 while memoAsString renders them as hex
handleResponse returns 3xx bodies as success
Fiat asset code causes ClassCastException in SEP-6 deposit and withdraw asset lookup
Instance validateAmount accepts implausible magnitudes and throws unchecked exceptions on malformed input
WebAuthJwtFilter finally block dereferences null token and masks the real authentication error
findings.evidence: filter/WebAuthJwtFilter.java:28 `"token created. account={} url={}", shorter(token.getAccount()), request.getRequestURL());`

findings.title: ErrorHelper hides the intended exception behind a generic RuntimeException when reflective construction fails
findings.evidence: util/ErrorHelper.java:13 `throw new RuntimeException("Error creating exception", e);`

findings.title: PropertyUtil.set/get throw an unchecked NoSuchElementException on an empty path
PlatformApiClient.health builds the checks query but requests endpoint + "/health", so the checks parameter is never sent
Horizon submitTransaction uses async submit and returns PENDING without polling; no caller in the reviewed set checks the final result
CallbackApiClient.sendEvent never closes the OkHttp response
GET /price crashes on a zero or null rate amount (no guard before total-price division)
Platform RPC responses are never closed, leaking OkHttp connections on every notification
Invalid base64 hash memo escapes as an unchecked exception instead of a validation error
Platform RPC client drops the endpoint path and ignores HTTP status, so funds-received/refund notifications can be silently lost
PropertyUtil.set accepts any dotted path, allowing class-metadata traversal and arbitrary no-arg instantiation (latent)
SEP-24 deposit and withdraw bind another account's SEP-38 quote without an ownership check
SEP-12 transaction_id ownership accepts a muxed sub-account for a G-account transaction
AuthConfig.secretString is not annotated @Secret, so the log exclusion would not hide it
Secret getters in SecretConfig lack @Secret, so the log redaction does not cover them
Soroban RPC submitTransaction returns the send status without polling the hash
Client header JWT accepted without audience or jti binding, so a captured signed header can be replayed within its lifetime
SEP-45 getChallenge signs every server-credentialed auth entry returned by the RPC simulation without checking its invocation tree
